entries.pattern: ^\[Info\] Ambiguous jal target 0x800(?:32A20|33BE0|38DE0) in function [A-Za-z0-9_]+, falling back to function lookup$
entries.rationale: The exact rebuilt ELF intentionally gives libultra/math weak aliases the same resident code addresses (__sinf/sinf/fsin, __cosf/cosf/fcos, and _bzero/bzero/blkclr). Runtime lookup preserves that exact address identity; generated manual sizes are bounded by the owning input object's .text range.

entries.pattern: ^\[Info\] Ambiguous jal target 0x801DCC74 in function start_scene_manager, falling back to function lookup$
entries.rationale: Three mutually exclusive scene overlays intentionally reuse VRAM 0x801DCC74. Runtime function lookup is required to select the function belonging to the currently loaded overlay; later runtime gates must exercise this transition.

The exact ROM entry assembly loads game_main into a register and tail-jumps with jr; preserving that register-indirect transfer through generated function lookup is faithful to the original entry sequence.
